media.note: Offsets and frame indices are computed relative to start_wallclock_local. The DVR-burnt clock reads 11:08:39 at frame 0; user-verified frame 15 corresponds exactly to the DVR clock rolling to 11:08:40, so the precise frame-0 wallclock is 11:08:39.500 (15/30 s before the rollover). fps confirmed 30/1 via ffprobe.

source_document.note: 4 pages: pp. 1-2 a typed phone note of the strike timeline (not handwritten), pp. 2-3 phone photos of the DeltaV 'Varostroj ZRA' trend (2026-02-03 21:00 to 02-04 18:00). Times in the note are minute-rounded; 'okolo' = about.

events.note: Steady-state growth begins (9 min after seeding). Size reference from another day on this pan (ZRA run 2026-10-30, datasets/microscope_annotations.csv, scripts/microscope_summary.py): median of operator-picked crystal chords 29 um at 2 min, 114 um at 37 min, 276 um at 79 min, 483 um at 122 min, 452-486 um at 160-170 min after seeding.

events.note: End of growth phase, 3 h 11 min after the 12:30 seeding note.
